create_entry.default:
In the Zepp app, open the settings of the Home Assistant mini app and paste this address:

`{url}`

It is the only key of the watch: keep it private. Then choose what the watch shows, in the settings of the watch app or in the options of the integration.

user.description: Adds a watch running Zepp OS, which its phone connects through a webhook of its own. To tell several watches apart, rename them afterwards.

data_description.areas: These areas come first, in this order; the others follow by name.
data_description.entities: A page per area, in this order. They can also be chosen in the settings of the watch app, among the entities exposed to Assist.
data_description.favorites: The first page of the watch, in this order.
data_description.pipeline: Answers the voice messages. The preferred pipeline if empty.
